## LinkedIn

**Platform:** LinkedIn
**Caption:**

Melbourne professionals are parking the same prestige cars in the same CBD and Inner East car parks every weekday this winter. Those cars are accumulating paint damage their owners won't see until spring — and by then, correction costs more than protection would have.

Winter is the hardest season for car paint, not summer. Rain strips unprotected sealant in weeks. Road grime from Melbourne's wet freeways bonds to clear coat rather than washing off. Bird droppings — more concentrated in colder months — etch into paint before anyone thinks to remove them. The damage is silent until it isn't.

We run mobile detailing and ceramic coating services across Melbourne's Inner East and Bayside suburbs — certified technicians come to the car's location during business hours, whether that's a home garage in Toorak or an office car park in South Yarra. No logistics, no drop-offs, no reminders to set. The car gets maintained while the owner is at their desk.

For professionals managing a company vehicle, or anyone running a prestige car through Melbourne winter without a coating on it — feel free to reach out directly for a ceramic assessment. The best time to protect the paint is before you can see the damage.
